| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Blobs** `blobs` | Bright blobs | Bright blobs, Dark blobs | Whether the blobs are brighter or darker than their surroundings. Dark blobs are found as bright blobs of the negated luma. |
| **Smallest sigma** `minSigma` | 1 | 0.5 to 50 px | The smallest scale. Blobs smaller than the matching radius are missed. |
| **Largest sigma** `maxSigma` | 50 | 1 to 100 px | The largest scale. scikit-image uses 50. If it is below the smallest sigma, only the smallest is used. |
| **Sigma ratio** `sigmaRatio` | 1.6 | 1.1 to 3 | The ratio k between neighboring scales. scikit-image uses 1.6 by default. |
| **Threshold** `threshold` | 0.2 | 0 to 1 | The smallest response a blob needs, for an image from 0 to 1. scikit-image uses 0.5, which finds nothing on the Disks image. 0.2 finds its six disks. |
| **Overlap** `overlap` | 0.5 | 0 to 1 | Of two blobs whose areas overlap by more than this share, the smaller goes. 1 keeps all. |
